lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: Anvil Yard, this is the courier requesting a berth.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Berth four. Mind the slag chutes, they don't stop for anybody.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: You've reached the only refinery for three systems that still pays on time. Mostly on time.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Ore in, alloy out. Everything that sparkles on this rock gets melted, stamped and shipped.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Welders, drillers, anyone who can read a pressure gauge. Contracts go up on the board when the foreman remembers.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: That noise? Crusher three. Or the reactor. Honestly they sound the same until one of them explodes.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Keep your hands inside the ship and your hull away from the magnets. Welcome to the Yard.

options.line: What actually comes out of this place?
What is that awful grinding noise?
